An employee review on Glassdoor Singapore is titled as describing a company with a very bad working culture. The result shows a 5.0 rating alongside the negative title, and the reviewer's location is not shown in the snippet.
items.entity_the_claim_is_about: Randstad (employer; the review is listed under Randstad on Glassdoor Singapore, office not confirmed)
items.quoted_evidence: Bad Company with very bad working culture - Recruitement Coordinator-Onboarding Randstad Employee Review

items.claim: A Portal da Queixa complaints page asks whether the Randstad brand is trustworthy. The result concerns Randstad in Portugal, not Singapore.
UK employment tribunal decisions list cases against Randstad Solutions Ltd and others. These are UK proceedings, not Singapore.
items.quoted_evidence: Mr C Yoong v Randstad Solutions Ltd and others

items.claim: A headline reports that a French competition body fined a recruiter for settlement violations. The headline does not name Randstad. A search summary links this to Randstad France, which is a different entity from Randstad Singapore.
items.entity_the_claim_is_about: Randstad France (recruiter named in summary only; not confirmed by the headline)
items.quoted_evidence: France fines recruiter for settlement violations

items.claim: A Randstad press release says Randstad lodged an appeal against a fine imposed by the Dutch regulator AFM. This concerns the Netherlands, not Singapore.
items.quoted_evidence: randstad lodges appeal against fine imposed afm

notes: No result showed a Singapore regulator penalty, enforcement action, court judgment or formal complaint record against Randstad Singapore. The Singapore-related items are scam and impersonation warnings published by Randstad itself, dated mostly 2022. The retrenchment search returned only general Singapore labour-market reporting that does not mention Randstad, so it produced no item. Several Singapore enforcement results (MOM arrests over phantom workers, a suspended employment agency licence over fee violations, and a staffing kickback arrest story) do not name Randstad in the result text, so they were excluded. The French and Dutch items and the UK tribunal cases are about other jurisdictions; the Glassdoor review's office location is not confirmed. Some figures in the search summaries, such as a US $50,000 penalty and the EUR 4.5 million French fine amount, were not visible in the result titles or links and were not used as claims.
